Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Enterprise Banking & E-Commerce Copilot (40% Public FAQ Queries, 60% Personalized Multi-Turn RAG/Agent Queries, 300 RPS)

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Unscoped Gateway Semantic Cache (`Cosine >= 0.90` on All Queries Without Entity/Date/Tenant Guard)
Configuration_Matrix.Caching_Mechanism: Dense Embedding Lookup Only; Returns Full Cached Text Response on Cosine >= 0.90
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Anti-pattern: `2025` vs `2026` or `NOT eligible` vs `eligible` have >0.96 cosine similarity!

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Gateway Exact SHA-256 Prompt String Cache Only (No Semantic Cache, No Engine Prefix KV Cache)
Configuration_Matrix.Caching_Mechanism: Exact Byte-for-Byte JSON Request Match in Redis
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Zero false-positive risk, but misses 93.5% of paraphrased FAQs and shared RAG/system prefixes

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Inference-Engine Exact Prefix KV Cache Only (`vLLM APC / SGLang RadixAttention`, Zero Response Cache)
Configuration_Matrix.Caching_Mechanism: Caches Exact Token-Block KV States for Shared System Prompts, Tools & Multi-Turn History
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Universal safe foundation for all multi-turn Agent, Tool-Calling, and personalized RAG workloads

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: 3-Layer Hybrid: `L1 Exact Hash` + `L2 Tenant/NER/Number-Guarded Cross-Encoder Semantic Cache` (Stateless FAQ Only) + `L3 Engine Prefix KV Cache` (All Flows)
Configuration_Matrix.Caching_Mechanism: Regex/NER Hard-Match on Dates/Numbers/SKUs + Cross-Encoder > 0.96 for Public FAQs; Radix KV Cache for Agent/RAG
Configuration_Matrix.Multi_Tenant_Data_Leak_Risk: ZERO (`tenant_id + rbac_role + extracted_entities` Composite Partition Key)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production gold standard: combines 8ms FAQ response hits (0.02% FP) with 100% exact Prefix KV caching (-54.2% TCO)
